'''Tinted Glass''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 4 × [[Glass]] +<br />[[Amethyst Shard]]) and a [[Mud Kiln]] recipe (from [[Amethyst Shard]]). See {{MCW|Tinted Glass}} for everything else.
